definitions.warm_layer_cohort: Internal L1-7 with release>=2000 and compute_end<=4000; complete lifecycle and wait, no boundary censoring.
definitions.role_occupancy: Clipped admission-completion resident NPU time, regardless of computing or waiting.
definitions.io_lifetime: ready-release includes SSD queue, disk service and NPU receive; not uninterrupted SSD service.
definitions.wave_scope: Only NPU0-19 in common initial consecutive Long prefix; guard exit is measured. No all32 or arbitrary random-prefix alignment.
definitions.nominal: Independently scanned currently admitted physical per-disk V/C; exact-time ties batched, no extra L0 nominal term.
definitions.limitation: Synchronized releases plus simultaneous short waits do not identify physical FIFO predecessors. No block-level causal trace generated. Selected seed7 only.
